steps.title: Paint-Over Targets · Street & Open
steps.body: Side-by-side comparison of current Outbreak captures vs Noir and Dusk paint-over targets (0 WebGPU cost).
steps.markdown:
### Key Visual Findings
- **#1 Value Structure (Darkness owns the frame)**: In the current captures (`street.png`, `open.png`), lawns, sidewalks, and yards are evenly lit. In the Noir and Dusk targets, darkness owns the frame outside the warm practical light pools and flashlight cone.
- **#2 Ground & Curb Detail**: Current sidewalks and roads read as clean gridded slabs and flat asphalt. Targets break up edges with cracked wet asphalt, weeds over curb joints, gravel, and fallen leaves.
